description:
Sets a key in the encrypted session payload and returns the updated decrypted payload. If the JSON body is `{ "value": <x> }`, the server unwraps it and stores `<x>` directly.

Source: POST /api/v1/sessions/set/{key}
Requires `auth.sessionToken` and forwards it as a Bearer token.
Prefer connection.workspaceName and connection.appId as stable config instead of generating identity fields dynamically.

body.description: JSON body can be either `{ "value": <x> }` (preferred) or a raw JSON value.

appId.description: Optional secureFlows app id used as a default for hosted login tools

host.description: secureFlows base URL, for example https://api.example.com

workspaceName.description: Optional workspace name used as a default for tools that need it

name: post_sessions_set_key
title: Set a value inside the session payload
